rules.statement: A contract for the sale of goods requires a sale and delivery of the goods within a year for the prescriptive period to apply.
rules.supporting_quote: No action shall be maintainable for or in respect of any goods sold and delivered, or for any shop bill or book debt, or for work and labour done, or for the wages of artisans, laborers, or servants, unless the same shall be brought within one year after the debt shall have become due.
